title: Berlin Brutalist Architecture - Quick Summary
items: **Do not call every grey building Brutalist.** In Berlin, the useful clue is whether structure, services and mass are deliberately left visible rather than merely whether concrete is present.
**Make Mäusebunker an exterior-first specialist detour.** Its projecting tubes and sloping form are the point; do not assume an interior visit is available.
**Use St. Agnes for the central stop.** It is a former church in Kreuzberg, now used by a gallery, so check current access on the day if you want to go inside.
**Treat Corbusierhaus and Haus des Lehrers as counterpoints.** They make the comparison better, but the article does not label either one Brutalist.
Use Berlin Concrete Clue Chain to learn one visible building clue at a time, then choose the detour that actually fits your day.
